name: WdMoveToTextMark
description: Marks the moved-to text when text in a document with tracked changes is moved from one place to another.

constants.name: wdMoveToTextMarkNone
constants.description: No special formatting for moved text.

constants.name: wdMoveToTextMarkBold
constants.description: Marks moved text with bold formatting.

constants.name: wdMoveToTextMarkItalic
constants.description: Marks moved text with italic formatting.

constants.name: wdMoveToTextMarkDoubleUnderline
constants.description: Moved text is marked with a double underline.

constants.name: wdMoveToTextMarkColorOnly
constants.description: Marks moved text with color only. Use the MoveToTextColor property to set the color of moved text.

constants.name: wdMoveToTextMarkStrikeThrough
constants.description: Moved text is marked with a strikethrough.

constants.name: wdMoveToTextMarkDoubleStrikeThrough
constants.description: Moved text is marked with a double strikethrough.
